title: Transaction
description: Contract for a single mobile-money transaction event. Shared by the PaySim batch data, the future Kafka producer/consumer, and the FastAPI serving layer, so all three agree on one wire format. Mirrors fraud_detection.domain.entities.Transaction.

step.description: Simulation time unit (1 step = 1 hour of PaySim simulated time).

oldbalanceOrg.description: Origin account balance before the transaction.

newbalanceOrig.description: Origin account balance after the transaction.

oldbalanceDest.description: Destination account balance before the transaction.

newbalanceDest.description: Destination account balance after the transaction.

isFraud.description: Ground-truth label present in PaySim historical data; absent on live Kafka events, which is what the model exists to predict.

isFlaggedFraud.description: PaySim's own rule-based flag for illegal attempts (large single transfers).
